name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A free collection of instruction files that teach an AI coding assistant how a seasoned engineer actually wants work done.
buyer: Honestly, nobody paying directly — this is free, personal-brand content for developers, built to funnel readers into the author's newsletter and courses rather than sold itself.
business_use_cases: A developer-education creator studies this as a lead-magnet playbook: give away configuration files, sell the newsletter and courses behind them.
A consulting shop adapts the skill files internally to standardize how its own engineers brief AI tools on client projects.
A dev tools company references popular skill repos like this one to decide which workflows to build native product support for.

money_ideas.idea: Not monetizable as a standalone product — its value is as free content that drives newsletter/course signups for its author.

steal_this: Don't clone the repo — clone the funnel: publish your own niche 'skills' file for a specific stack and use it to build an email list for a paid course.
